purpose: Teach: 桂/柏/藍/圭/乃/嘉/肇/ヨウ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「桂剥きはコツが要る」って料理を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught me that peeling a katsura requires a special touch.
lines.style: Soft, warm voice. Distant focus—remembering something your father said. Unhurried pace, almost lost in the thought. Gentle end-weight on the learning itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと柏の葉っぱを集めたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went out with Dad today and collected oak leaves together.
lines.style: Bright, direct. Eager to share. Quick at the start, settling into pride as the words come. Small person's voice—clear and present. Wanting her to hear what he did.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが藍染めの手拭いを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave me a beautiful indigo-dyed hand towel.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude underneath. Voice softens on the word 'indigo'—the gift itself is precious. Slow and deliberate. The kind of moment that sits gently in a room.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと圭くんの家に遊びに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went over to Kei's house to play yesterday.
lines.style: Straightforward child's delivery. Small smile in the voice. Eager but not demanding—he's just checking that she knows what he's been doing. Matter-of-fact warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお手紙の宛名に「美乃君」って書かれてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad wrote my name—'Mino'—in the address line of a letter.
lines.style: Distant and wondering. Voice catches slightly on the name, as if the specificity of it has struck her. Slow. Breathing a little deeper at the end. She's noticing something quiet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと嘉永年間の和歌を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I read an old poem from the Kaei period with Dad.
lines.style: Proud and soft. Not boasting—sharing something he knows is a little special. Careful with the word 'poem,' like it matters. Young voice holding something grown.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「物事の肇を大事に」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad teaches me that treasuring the beginning of things is what matters most.
lines.style: Slow and careful. Each word placed deliberately—this is wisdom being passed along. Quiet, almost reverent. A breath between 'beginning' and 'what matters.' Voice settles at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ヨウ素うがい液は風邪予防に良い」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me that gargling with iodine solution helps prevent colds.
lines.style: Earnest, close proximity. Sharing practical knowledge with pride. Small voice, serious tone. Like he's been entrusted with something important. Finishes with quiet certainty.
